name: Appointy
description_en:
Appointy is an online appointment system for service businesses, combining a booking page, staff/service availability, reminders, payments and customer management. It also documents classes, resources and multi-location operation, with those capabilities gated by plan.

A perpetual Free plan and a full-feature 14-day trial are separate offers. A workflow built during the trial needs to be checked against the plan that will remain afterwards.
description_zh:
Appointy 是面向服务业务的在线预约系统，结合预约页、员工／服务可用时间、提醒、付款与客户管理，也列有课程、资源及多地点运营，但相关能力受套餐约束。

永久免费方案与完整功能的 14 天试用是两种不同安排。试用期间搭建的流程，需要按之后实际保留的套餐重新核对。

core_features.explanation_en: Set service/staff hours, buffers and booking restrictions.
core_features.explanation_zh: 设置服务／员工时间、缓冲及预约限制。

core_features.explanation_en: Professional documents staff logins and resource scheduling.
core_features.explanation_zh: Professional 列有员工登录与资源排程。

core_features.explanation_en: Free has defined staff/service/appointment limits; every plan can export data.
core_features.explanation_zh: Free 有明确员工／服务／预约上限；所有方案可导出数据。

en: Offer customer self-booking within real staff and service availability.
zh: 按真实员工与服务时间提供客户自助预约。
use_cases.basis: Illustrative selection guidance; no customer outcome or hands-on claim.

Deployment.en: Vendor hosted booking system with mobile access and external integrations.
Deployment.zh: 厂商托管预约系统，提供移动访问与外部集成。

steps.en: Configure one service, staff hours and buffer rules.
steps.zh: 配置一种服务、员工时间与缓冲规则。

steps.en: Share/embed the page and check booking, rescheduling and reminders with a disposable record.
steps.zh: 分享／嵌入页面，用临时记录检查预订、改期与提醒。

steps.en: Recheck the intended post-trial plan and export route before real customer rollout.
steps.zh: 面向真实客户前重新核对试用后的目标套餐及导出方式。

items.en: Appointy documents prepayments, reminders, cancellation restrictions and data export on every plan. If a payment or calendar handoff fails, inspect both systems before recreating the booking, then retain an export before migration or cancellation; this is handling advice, not a transaction guarantee. It fits businesses needing customer self-service and staff availability. No live booking, refund, export, failure recovery, self-hosted edition or open-source licence was verified. Detailed payment-help retrieval was 403, so processor edge cases remain open.
items.zh: Appointy 文档列预付款、提醒、取消限制，并说明所有方案均可导出数据。支付或日历交接失败时，建议先核对两边系统再重建预约，迁移或取消前保留导出；这不是事务保证。它适合需要客户自助与员工可用时间的业务。未验证真实预订、退款、导出、故障恢复、自行部署版或开源许可。详细支付帮助读取遇到 403，因此支付渠道边界仍待确认。

pricing.billing_basis: Plan subscription plus staff/location extras; annual/monthly options.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Free 1 staff/5 services/100 appointments monthly. Annual monthly-equivalents $19.99/$49.99/$79.99; monthly $29.99/$59.99/$99.99. No-card trial 14 days, then Free unless upgraded.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 免费一员工／五服务／每月 100 预约。年付月均 19.99／49.99／79.99 美元；按月 29.99／59.99／99.99。无需信用卡试用 14 天，未升级则降至免费。

sections.title_en: Define services before sharing a booking link
sections.title_zh: 分享预约链接前先定义服务
sections.en: The official three-step flow starts with services and working hours, including buffers, blocked time and irregular availability, then sharing a link or embedding the widget. An illustrative studio pilot adds one service and one staff calendar, takes a test booking and reschedules it through the intended customer path. Resource scheduling and separate staff logins are paid-plan considerations, so do not configure a room-dependent workflow under assumptions drawn from a temporary trial.
sections.zh: 官方三步流程先定义服务和工作时间，包括缓冲、阻挡时段与不规则可用时间，再分享链接或嵌入组件。工作室试点可先添加一项服务和一个员工日历，创建测试预约，再按目标客户路径改期。资源排程和独立员工登录涉及付费档，不能依据临时试用的权限假定长期方案可运行依赖房间的流程。

sections.title_en: The small free plan and the downgrade path
sections.title_zh: 小型免费方案与降级路径
sections.en: Free includes one staff member, five services and 100 appointments per month, plus website integration, Square and reminders on the plan page. Growth adds Google calendar sync/iCal and additional prepayment processors; Professional includes five staff, staff logins and resources. The no-card 14-day trial automatically downgrades to Free if no upgrade is chosen. Test the retained free configuration rather than assuming the full trial workflow survives unchanged.
sections.zh: 套餐页列 Free 含一员工、五服务、每月 100 预约，以及网站集成、Square 与提醒。Growth 增加 Google 日历同步／iCal 和更多预付支付渠道；Professional 含五员工、员工登录与资源。无需信用卡的 14 天试用在未选择升级时自动降至 Free。应测试长期保留的免费配置，不能假定完整试用流程原样保留。

sections.title_en: Annual equivalents, extra staff and fair use
sections.title_zh: 年度折算、额外员工与公平用量
sections.en: The USD page shows Growth $19.99/month annually or $29.99 monthly; Professional $49.99 or $59.99; Enterprise $79.99 or $99.99, with two locations included in Enterprise. Extra staff and locations have separate prices. Paid appointment volume is subject to a stated 2,000-per-day fair-use limit; “unlimited services” is not a guarantee of unlimited operational throughput. Provider charges, tax, SMS rules and exact extra-location cadence need confirmation for the intended account.
sections.zh: 美元页列 Growth 年付折算每月 19.99、按月 29.99；Professional 49.99 或 59.99；Enterprise 79.99 或 99.99，Enterprise 含两个地点。额外员工和地点另有价格。付费预约量受每日 2,000 次公平使用限制；“服务不限”不保证运营吞吐无限。目标账户需确认支付渠道费、税、短信规则和额外地点确切账期。

research_gaps.en: Live processor/refund behaviour, SMS charges, integration permissions, extra-location billing and recovery/export fidelity were not tested. Payment-help article was 403.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试真实支付／退款、短信费用、集成权限、额外地点计费及恢复／导出保真度；支付帮助文章读取为 403。
